authority_semantics: version .3 passed bounded 2023 lifecycle replay and stratified outcome-blind visual review; this is descriptive primitive authority, not profitability or broad-regime stability

definitions.started: the first completed bar with a non-zero directional body, at least one tick of same-direction close progress versus the strictly prior close, and a close in the directional half of its own range
definitions.active: after at least two admitted bars, cumulative net displacement, efficiency, ATR speed, mean body fraction and directional-body continuity all meet their frozen definitions at the same completed-bar clock
definitions.interruption: a completed bar without a new favorable close; at most one consecutive neutral, stalled or small opposite interruption is admitted while origin, protection and cumulative direction remain intact
definitions.started_recovery: after a STARTED candidate has an interruption, a favorable close resets the interruption only when it crosses at least one additional cumulative ACTIVE gate or becomes ACTIVE; one-tick drift cannot renew a weak candidate forever
definitions.opposite_probe: a single opposite impulse is only an internal candidate; once started, its completed bars use the same interruption, protection and cumulative ACTIVE semantics as the primary episode; qualified opposite displacement requires its frozen prefix to satisfy the exact same cumulative ACTIVE definition
definitions.exhausted: a completed close strictly breaks the frozen protection price, a pending opposite prefix becomes ACTIVE, or a second consecutive interruption confirms loss of progress
definitions.protection: the first candidate bar low for a long episode and high for a short episode; it is frozen for the entity lifetime
definitions.same_clock_order: commit old EXHAUSTED before promoted opposite STARTED and ACTIVE; progress-loss cannot create a same-clock same-direction replacement
definitions.activation_window: absent; a still-causal STARTED episode is never terminalized only because a fixed bar count elapsed
definitions.terminal_geometry: the terminal evidence bar is not admitted to the old episode; a new opposite STARTED entity may use that same completed bar after the old terminal transition is committed

metrics.travel_points: seed_body_travel plus absolute close-to-close travel of every later admitted bar
metrics.mean_overlap_ratio: mean adjacent-bar price-range intersection divided by the smaller of the two completed-bar ranges; the seed has no adjacent pair and reports zero
metrics.max_overlap_ratio: maximum adjacent-bar overlap ratio across the admitted episode prefix; the seed reports zero
metrics.mean_directional_clv: mean direction-relative close location value across all admitted episode bars
metrics.body_continuity: same-direction body points / (same-direction body points + opposite-direction body points); neutral bodies do not enter the denominator
metrics.interruption_run: consecutive admitted bars since the last qualifying recovery; STARTED recovery must improve the cumulative activation gate count
metrics.activation_gate_count: number of cumulative ACTIVE conditions currently satisfied, including minimum evidence length
metrics.activation_weakest_ratio: minimum normalized ratio across the cumulative ACTIVE conditions

downstream_contract.fvg: must bind the exact ACTIVE episode identity and admitted prefix
downstream_contract.order_block: must bind the exact ACTIVE episode identity plus confirmed BOS
downstream_contract.playbooks: may consume displacement identity and lifecycle but may not reinterpret its bars
